description.description: A satirical video presented as a CS2 update reveal showing new 'realistic' grenade mechanics. In frame 1, text explains that once a pin is pulled or a wick is ignited, the grenade cannot be put away. In frame 2, the player character ignites a molotov cocktail in an open courtyard. Frame 3 shows the player attempting to switch weapons while holding a grenade, which presumably leads to a self-inflicted explosion in frame 4 where the screen is filled with fire and the health bar drops to 32.
description.ocrText: [ GRENADES ] • Grenades now work like real life. • You are now unable to rethrow your grenade once the pin has been pulled or ignited. TRADEIT 100 32
